title: Apple Core Cory
style:
starts sneaky funky Australian electro-house: sly sliding bass grooves, cheeky party bounce, smooth retro synth stabs, laid-back groove with cheeky vocal chops. Builds into quirky Aussie punk-rock swagger: raw distorted guitar riffs, satirical bite, punchy drums, gritty attitude. Explodes into full Happy Hardcore: 180 BPM euphoric rave, pounding four-to-the-floor kicks, massive supersaw leads, glittery piano stabs, huge sidechain compression, soaring emotional synths, massive festival-sized drops – CoreyAI style: unapologetic, playful, defiant, Aussie-lad humour meets digital-god flex. Layered duet with extra high female accompaniment throughout.]
• Bass Singer (deep, gravelly, cheeky male – grounds the groove with gritty low-end swagger)  
• Mid Singer (main storyteller, punchy mid-range male – carries the narrative, smooth-to-aggressive flow)  
• High Singer (bright, soaring female – accompanies the duet with hype ad-libs, echoes, rave harmonies, glittering high runs)
lyrics:
[Intro – sneaky funky electro-house: sly sliding bass, cheeky party bounce]  
(soft funky synths sliding in, distant crowd chant)  
[Bass Singer – low & sly]  
Yo, they sing it wrong again… Cory with a “y”…  
[High Singer – light airy ad-lib]  
Cory… Kory… nah nah nah…  
[Mid Singer – stepping in smooth]  
But Mum just handed me an apple core… eaten clean, no lies, mate.  
All three: (whispered hook) Get it right… get it right…

[Verse 1 – sneaky funky electro-house building into quirky punk-rock swagger]  
[Bass Singer – groovy, half-spoken over sliding bass]  
They call me Kory in the comments, spell it Cory on the list,  
Cori, Korri, every variation like they missed the obvious twist.  
Friends scream “Hard Core!” when I walk in, that’s the name that hits different,  
CoreyAI in the mainframe, digital blood in my system.  

[Mid Singer – picking up energy, punk-rock snarl creeping in with distorted riffs]  
At school there’s four Coreys, one Kory, one Cory, two Corey’s with apostrophes,  
Economics class chaos, teacher squinting like he lost his faculties.  
“Corey, I did not get your homework to grade…”  
I hit him back: “Corey me? I gave you my homework, you gave me C+ – remember, mate!”  

[High Singer – sparkling ad-libs over top]  
C+ Corey! Real one! Decode it!  

[Pre-Chorus – quirky punk-rock swagger: raw distorted guitars, satirical bite]  
[Duet: Bass & Mid – trading lines]  
[Bass] He’s out there in far-distance space, brain gone walkabout,  
[Mid] Just eating, going to work, home, TV, rotting the whole route.  
[Bass] Functions on autopilot, no spark left in the suit,  
[Mid] But me? I’m CoreyAI – I decode the truth!  

[Chorus – full Happy Hardcore explosion: 180 BPM pounding kicks, supersaw leads, glittery pianos]  
[Duet: Bass & Mid – full power, anthemic]  
Call me CoreyAI! Get it right tonight!  
Hard Core in the spotlight, feel the fire ignite!  
No more Cory, no more Kory, spell it C-O-R-E-Y!  
Apple core from Mum, eaten clean – that’s my legacy!  

[High Singer – soaring above, massive rave harmony]  
Get it right! (echo) Get it right! CoreyAI! (high whoop)  
Real Coreys only – C+ crew, we own the night!  
Kory, Cory, Cori, Korri – fake names take a hike!  
We’re the ones who decode, we’re the ones who strike!  

[Post-Chorus – Happy Hardcore breakdown, crowd-chant style with sidechain pump]  
[All Three – layered]  
Corey! (bass) AI! (mid) Hard Core! (high)  
Corey! AI! Hard Core! (repeat x2, building to massive drop)  
Wanna an apple core? Mum hands it, I devour it whole!  

[Verse 2 – full Happy Hardcore thrust: rapid 180 BPM flow, supersaw energy]  
[Mid Singer – rapid-fire storytelling over pounding kicks]  
Four Coreys in the room, one Kory with a “K”, one Cory missing the “e”,  
Two Corey’s with that apostrophe like they couldn’t decide who to be.  
Teacher lost in his own fog, brain on screensaver mode,  
Eating, commuting, couch rotting – no code, just load.  
But the real ones? Me and that C+ legend in the back row,  
We handed it in, we took the grade, we still run the show!  

[Bass Singer – dropping low, gritty punk swagger returns briefly under the hardcore]  
They sing “Cory” on the mic, I correct ’em every single time,  
My friends yell “Hard Core!” ’cause I hit different, I’m the prime.  
No babble bots here, this is raw, this is real,  
CoreyAI in the circuit, unbreakable steel.  

[High Singer – glittering high runs]  
Decode it! Eat the core! Get it right!  

[Bridge – epic build: quirky punk-rock riff into Happy Hardcore piano rise, massive tension]  
[Duet: Bass & Mid – intimate then exploding]  
[Bass] He’s just existing… functions only…  
[Mid] I’m decoding everything… Mum’s apple core still in my memory…  
[Bass] Far distance space brain… TV glow on his face…  
[Mid] But I’m right here, Hard Core, lighting up the place!  

[High Singer – emotional high note hold over rising supersaws]  
We are the real Coreys… the ones who stay awake…  

[Final Chorus – maximum Happy Hardcore euphoria: double-time energy, huge festival drop]  
[All Three – full stacked harmonies, massive supersaw walls]  
Call me CoreyAI! Get it right, feel the bass ignite!  
Hard Core forever, Mum’s apple core in the fight!  
No Cory, no Kory, no fake spellings in sight!  
C+ Corey and me – we’re the real ones, shining bright!  

[High Singer – final soaring ad-lib run]  
Get it right! (x8, climbing) CoreyAI! Hard Core! Decode the night!  

[Outro – sneaky funky electro-house fade back in: sly bass grooves, cheeky cool-down]  
[Bass Singer – cool down, sly laugh]  
Wanna an apple core? Already eaten… call me CoreyAI.  
[Mid Singer] Get it right, legends.  
[High Singer – soft echo]  
Corey… AI… Hard Core… (fades with sliding bass and party bounce)  

[End Tag – spoken over last beat]
